# Industrial light

`industrial.json` is baked from "Industrial Light" by ConhuirParker
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/industrial-light-0bcbb6f2a3e54b6b8c69e241bbd5bc5f),
licensed CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: geometry quantised, base colour and emissive
textures reduced to 512 px, other textures dropped; tinted red in-game for the bar marker.
